description_md: Row number of the hour in the pinned source file; primary key (Cruise + SB# + Date + Hour is not unique: a recording file can end and the next start inside one hour).
CalCOFI station 'LLL.L SSS.S' from line + station.
Nominal station latitude from line/station (`cc_calcofi_to_lonlat()`); the sonobuoy's own position is not recorded.
Start of the analysed hour, Date + Hour read as UTC (Q04).
CalCOFI cruise key from `match_cruise_by_track()` against the ichthyo station track, majority vote per cruise_label.
CalCOFI grid cell of the nominal station position.
